did.rationale: Reviewed 2026-10-29: this added GitHub workflow runs Python downstream compatibility checks when the R repository changes. It does not alter R sources, tests, build inputs or numerical fixtures. Only these exact added regular-file bytes are accepted; subsequent edits require review.

version_metadata.rationale: Reviewed 2026-10-29: the R did repository's existing bump-version workflow increments the fourth DESCRIPTION version component when the downstream-caller PR is merged. Accept only this single expected metadata edit; every other DESCRIPTION byte remains identical to the pinned baseline. This does not advance the numerical fixtures or accept later version bumps.
